值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入解析《陰森之子》與前作《陰森》錯綜複雜的世界觀關聯，釐清跨代劇情的神秘脈絡。
  • 詳解主角在危機四伏的島嶼上求生、對抗黃金面具食人族與地底變異畸形生物的驚險過程。
  • 揭露帕夫集團、前作角色提米（Timmy）的平行宇宙理論，以及神秘「索拉菲特」礦石與黃金立方體的真實面貌。

摘要

墜機生還與搜救的殘酷開端

主角傭兵Jack跟隨搜救隊搭乘直升機前往帕夫集團買下的豪華度假島嶼，旨在尋找失蹤31週的集團董事長Edward Puff及其妻女。不料直升機在空中遭遇不明武裝襲擊墜毀，Jack 在被神秘人擊昏後倖存，身邊僅留下一只多功能背包與受傷失聰的隊友Kelvin。作者指出，隨著利用 GPS 尋找其他成員，Jack 陸續發現吊掛崖壁與死在救生筏上的同伴，甚至遍地可見礦工與前批搜救人員的遺體，整座島嶼早已淪為殘酷的殺戮場。

地表營地威脅與幽深洞穴中的變異怪物

面對島上嚴苛的四季變化，作者與無法言語的 Kelvin 合作搭建簡易庇護所求生。島上充斥著極具攻擊性的野人，其中配戴黃金面具的強壯食人族尤為棘手。然而更駭人的威脅潛藏於地下洞穴，幽暗中盤踞著體型巨大且攻擊力驚人的手指怪、雙人合體匍匐的畸形肉塊以及各類不可名狀的變異生物，整座島嶼的地下深處儼然已化為群魔亂舞的巢穴。

地下避難所的發現與撒哈拉公司的神秘遺產

在探索洞穴的過程中，作者不僅見到描繪黃金立方體的古代壁畫，更深入帕夫集團興建的地下現代化避難所，使用3D列印機製造防禦裝備。避難所中遺留著前作主角之子Timmy所撰寫關於平行宇宙的書籍，劇情由此揭開一代撒哈拉公司利用神秘神器跨越時空獻祭、試圖復活死者卻頻頻引發肉體異變的黑暗歷史。

提米的平行宇宙理論與島上的神秘礦石

長大後的 Timmy 將自己半成功復活、必須壓制手臂突變的經歷與夢境寫成理論，引起了熱衷平行時空的帕夫集團高層注意。帕夫集團循線展開調查，在島上發掘出擁有超自然力量的索拉菲特（Solafite）礦石，以及一座結構精密、疑似能夠抵禦或引發異變的神秘黃金立方體，逐步揭示富豪度假天堂背後令人不寒而慄的終極秘密。

================================================

This was once a paradise-like island where the wealthy built luxurious underground facilities, turning it into a vacation hotspot. However, savages roam the island, and the caves are crawling with monsters—indescribable things that shouldn't even exist in this world. Thinking they had arrived at a sunny paradise, they actually stepped into a purgatory. But the rich aren't stupid; they should have at least conducted thorough surveys of the island . How could they choose to build a resort in such a place? Or perhaps, did these monsters only appear after they arrived? Until the protagonist also landed on this island. The truth of. everything was gradually revealed with the 2023 release of the sequel to*The Forest*, *Sons of the Forest*. The hallmark of this series is that it doesn't spell out the story; all clues must be pieced together like unraveling a mystery from what we see and read. It also touches on content from the first game, so if you haven't played the prequel, you'll be left in the dark. The game has undergone several major updates , so the content and ending we see now are completely different from the initial stages. If you've watched early videos or played the game a long time ago, it's worth watching along. *The Forest*is too chaotic and visually overwhelming in multiplayer, so when covering the main storyline, I'll be playing solo and embarking on this adventure on this picturesque island with all of you. Protagonist. Protagonist Jack and a team of mercenaries arrive by helicopter over a small island. This island was previously bought by PuffCorp to be turned into a luxury vacation resort for the wealthy, but 31 weeks ago, everyone on the island went missing, including PuffCorp chairman Edward Puff, his wife , and their daughter Virginia. Jack and his team came to the island to find the whereabouts of the chairman's family, but as soon as they arrived over the island, they were attacked by unknown armed forces. The helicopter plummeted under heavy fire, and Jack was thrown from the craft ; before he could react, the chopper crashed into him, which hurt a bit. Waking up, a stranger stood before him, originally intending to. Finish Jack off , but for some unknown reason, after a brief hesitation, he just knocked him unconscious. Waking up again, he found himself unharmed, and his emergency. supplies had also fallen beside him. Don't let the small size of this folded backpack fool you; it can actually hold a massive amount of gear. The bag currently contains an axe, a GPS, a crafting guidebook, and the standard nuclear lighter. However, this one is now windproof, so its lighting effect inside the caves isn't quite as good. After looking around, I found another survivor named Kelvin. He was part of the armed team, but he likely hit his head, causing damage to his intelligence and hearing. He can't communicate verbally, so I have to give him orders using written notes. From then on, Kelvin stayed by my side as a helpful assistant. However, he won't enter caves.

or underground areas; he only helps out when we're operating in the wild. The mountain is covered in snow, but after heading down for a while, the scenery gradually turns green. The weather is nice and sunny today, but the protagonist is in no mood to enjoy the scenery; the top priority is finding the other companions from the plane. Using the GPS to track their locations, the first teammate was found hanging from a cliff by a rope—no one knows by whom. Cutting the rope allows you to head down and loot his gear. Another teammate's signal was in the ocean. I ran over and found him shot dead on a life raft, clearly killed while trying to escape the island. The good news is that I found a pistol next to him. The bad news. is that there's a shark nearby, and swimming back blindly would surely... result in getting bitten. There's no other way; I have no choice but to start a fight. Sigh, what a waste of a precious bullet. You can also find the corpses of other armed personnel on the island. They wear the same uniforms as the helicopter crew, but they weren't part of our group. They must have come to the island for search and rescue earlier, but were attacked and killed. In many places, you can also find dead miners; it seems this armed group didn't even spare the workers. Jack’s heart sank, and he could only take the silent Kelvin with him to start uncovering the secrets of the island. The map in the. second game is several times larger than the first. The seasons are distinct, and if you live on the island long enough, you can see the scenery change across spring, summer, autumn, and winter. The protagonist of the previous game was a survival expert who could craft complex items. This entry has significantly simplified crafting requirements; for example, you only need two sticks to build a campfire. Saving is also very convenient. You just need to place a tarp on the ground and prop it up with a stick to create a simple shelter for sleeping and saving. Although the energy recovered is minimal, we can also restore it by drinking beverages or eating food; there are many ways. There are many cannibal camps on the island. Regardless of their size or type, these cannibals attack on sight. Ordinary cannibals can be taken down with a single headshot from a bow, but these strong cannibals wearing golden masks take two or three shots to kill, which is quite troublesome. Burning the cannibals 'bodies and crafting some bone armor can provide effective protection for your body. Defense—besides the cannibals, there are even more terrifying monsters on the island. Sometimes, the cannibals even kidnap monsters and bring them back, perhaps as a reserve food supply? The cannibals in this village captured a monster we used to call the "Finger Monster." Just look at how many arrows I shot to know how hard this thing is to fight if it’s not. tied up. Encounter. Dealing with cannibals is one thing, but the island’s caves are the truly terrifying part. You need nerves of steel to explore them alone. The light is dim, filled with all sorts of shrieks; you might get a "surprise" at any moment. A flare to the face reveals a Finger Monster. Their attack power is insane—they shattered my bones in just two or three hits. There’s also what we call the basic mob, the most common enemy in the caves. They usually appear in groups of three or four. They have no eyes and rely on sound to navigate, so you can just sneak around them. This.

monster looks like a spider at first, but if you look closer, it’s more like two people fused together, crawling on their hands. The best strategy is to target their limbs first to stun them, then it’s easier to focus your fire. This mountain of flesh has massive HP, wasting tons of ammo to kill. But because they are so bulky, they often glitch out—like this one, which is now just a target dummy. There are many other monsters, too. Every so often, you see bizarre-looking creatures. The whole island underground is a chaotic, bustling nest of demons. Beyond the monsters, the caves also show traces of human activity. Here’s an ancient mural painted in gold, depicting a cube. People around it are either lying on the ground or in strange poses, while those inside the cube seem perfectly fine. Deep inside a cave, I found traces of man-made structures. Yes, this isn't a deserted island. After PuffCorp bought it, they hired tons of workers to build underground facilities, planning to turn it into a paradise resort. This bunker is fully equipped now. The 3D printer nearby can print all sorts of things,. including arrows and water flasks. You can even print a mask to wear, which is great for scaring off regular cannibals . Inside the bunker, there's also a book about parallel universes, written by Timmy, the son of the first game's protagonist. From this moment on, the island's secrets slowly began to unravel . One. The protagonist's plane crashes on a small island, and his son, Timmy, is kidnapped. The kidnapper was a researcher for the giant pharmaceutical company, Sahara, and took Timmy to use as a sacrifice to resurrect his own daughter, because there is a mysterious. "Room Cup" on the island. Sahara had researched this cup and reached a shocking conclusion: it can connect our current spacetime to other parallel universes. By linking these spaces, it can pull a version of one's life from a parallel universe into a current body, thereby allowing the dead to be resurrected. However, it first requires a life to be sacrificed. By the time the protagonist found his son Timmy, he had already been sacrificed. The protagonist was naturally devastated, and he then did something unthinkable: he used the artifact to bring down another plane flying over the island, sacrificing an innocent person to trade for his son. Timmy's life. In fact, all previous resurrection experiments with the Room Cup had failed, resulting in bodies turning into indescribable monsters; even that researcher couldn't succeed. But Timmy's resurrection actually worked , though his body didn't return to its exact original state; his arms would swell and mutate, which he had to struggle to suppress each time. Regarding why Timmy's resurrection was successful, one theory is that because Timmy had already been sacrificed once, there was a "true self" of his in a parallel universe. This was equivalent to pulling his original self back, which is why he was able to barely maintain a.

human form with a lower degree of mutation. After growing up, Timmy wrote a book, combining his experiences and strange dreams to discuss his theories on parallel universes. His book caught the attention of the Pav Group, as Pav himself was very interested in things like parallel spacetime. Through investigation, they discovered that there is a type of "Solafite" ore on this island—a special metal that possesses magical powers. At the same time, there is an even stranger golden cube on the island, which looks as if it were crafted from Solafite ore. This cube might be like the Room Cup, possessing the ability to shift. dimensions and thereby connect to another spacetime. The Pav Group won the competition against Sahara, gaining the rights to develop the island. Initially , they publicly claimed they would turn the island into a vacation paradise for the wealthy, then later made a high-profile announcement that they had discovered Solafite ore on the island. They claimed the ore has magical properties, and if its mysteries can be unlocked, it might eventually lead to the development of technology to delay aging or even achieve human immortality . This is Pav's official narrative to the public, meant to secure high-level funding while covering up the truth: the. Golden Cube they discovered deep underground. In reality, Kimi had already landed on the island by this time. You encounter him while exploring underground, where you can see his hand mutation has become increasingly severe . Kimi and the protagonist clearly knew each other before, as he warns that this place is extremely unsafe and tells him to leave, before heading off himself. Kimi’s goal for this trip is to use the Cube to find a way to fix his body. After discovering the Cube, Pav, the boss of the Pav Group, moved onto the island to live, and he often has dreams about parallel universes, even dreaming of being in a city that is clearly not. of human civilization. Because he keeps having the same dream, Pav sketched out the scenes from them, and later, it becomes clear that his dreams were quite accurate. This happens because the area where Pav lives is very close to the Golden Cube, and since he is a sensitive individual, he is highly reactive to the radiation emitted by the Cube, allowing him to see these strange visions. But the Golden Cube didn’t just attract the Pav Group; there are also many robed corpses on the island who could perceive the Cube's radiation, and they formed a cult called "Neo-Knowledge," fanatically worshipping the Cube and the mysterious. city from their dreams. They believe that by discarding their physical bodies on this island, they can reach that mysterious city, so crowds have come to the island to end their lives, and you can see how insane they are from the blurry footage on the security tapes. The Pav Group’s research on the Cube has not been smooth sailing; they have a powerful rival, the pharmaceutical company "Sahara" from the previous game . Sahara lost the competition for the island but never gave up their obsession with the mysterious object found there. They planted an undercover agent within the Pav Group, the game's most important villain, "Zhang Jianyu," who was the one.

who knocked the protagonist out with a pistol whip at the beginning. This person holds the position of legal counsel for the Pav Group, giving him access to top-secret information, but the group soon realized how dangerous he was. From secret emails, it’s clear that Pav has assigned his trusted subordinates to keep a close watch on Zhang Jianyu’s every move while continuing research on the Cube. They have found a way to soft-boot the Cube, and after a period of time, it will be activated, though what will happen after that is impossible to predict. Some of those in the know are deeply worried, feeling that the risks are too high and the Cube should not be activated lightly. . But Puff insisted on launching the activation project, while simultaneously sensing Zhang Jianyu's ambition and the closing net of the Sahara Company. Knowing he was in danger, Puff made arrangements that if anything happened to him, they should immediately contact the protagonist, Jack, to bring help to the island. In fact, Jack is not a private investigator or a special forces operative; he is a media professional, and you can find a biography he wrote about Puff on the island. Puff deeply trusted this media professional he had frequent contact with, believing that even in the worst-case scenario, Jack's arrival would at least protect his. daughter, Virginia. Puff is worthy of being the founder of a major conglomerate; overall, he has a clear head and foresight, having indeed anticipated many things. Combined with the underground bunker discovered during the investigation, 31 weeks ago, the Puff Group invited celebrities from all walks of life to dine there and announce some of their research findings. However , through the surveillance room footage , one could see these celebrities, including Puff and his wife, all mutating into twisted monsters in almost an instant. The protagonist, bold and daring, used a VIP keycard to open the dining hall door , and the scene he witnessed was exactly as seen on the monitors, though there was another group there besides him. Zhang Jianyu had also arrived here with his men. After confirming that the Puff couple had mutated into monsters and seeing the protagonist arrive, Zhang Jianyu didn't waste any words, jumping out of a window and escaping quickly via an underground river, leaving the protagonist to deal with the couple. alone. I must say, these two don't look very agile, but they are quite difficult to handle; being hit by their heavy punches will knock you straight to the ground. The good news is that the Puff couple now recognizes no one, attacking the other monsters in the room with heavy blows indiscriminately. It took quite a lot of effort to eliminate all the monsters, including the couple themselves. After investigating the table, I found the name tag of Puff's daughter, Virginia, confirming that she must have been here at the time, though she is nowhere to be found now. Continuing the exploration, I found a cave on the other side of the island; it was initially just a narrow crevice, but inside it opened up into a whole new.

world. While fighting monsters and fumbling forward, I surprisingly discovered an ancient ruin, with walls and passages made of a special metal. Here, one can find another mural depicting the golden cube, once again hinting that as long as a person is inside the cube, they are safe. But this cave is far from safe, filled with mutated monsters everywhere, especially the flesh-mountain mutants which are tough to kill. Surprisingly, I encountered three of them in a row that got glitched; I was really lucky. Don't forget to triple-tap that like button! Deep in the cave, I found many corpses, and the clothes they were wearing looked just like spacesuits. Walking a bit further, I looked up to see an even more. shocking sight: before me was a spacecraft that didn't belong to this era, or perhaps, didn't belong to this dimension at all. Lightning kept striking the ship's hull from above. Inside the ship, there were many wooden crosses, and a corpse at the very front —likely the pilot. The small orb in his hand is one of the artifact fragments; several others can be found elsewhere on the island. The golden armor he's wearing is a vital item—I’m definitely taking it. As for where the ship and the astronauts actually came from, the game doesn't explicitly state it, so I can only guess. They likely traveled here from another dimension. The Puffton. Corporation also discovered these astronauts, which further convinced them that the cube could facilitate travel between parallel universes. The environment on the island is becoming increasingly perilous, but Jack has finally located the golden cube. The Puffton Corporation built an underground facility, with the couple's living quarters at the deepest level. The wall behind their bathroom has been blown open by the cultists, revealing a passage that leads to a sealed metal door. Jie had already arrived here, but no matter how hard we both tried, we couldn't open the door. After searching around, I found a note on a nearby corpse; the drawings on it were the key. clue to opening the door. I have to say , this part is really tedious; we have to find four golf cart batteries. Golf carts are a new vehicle in this installment. Since the island was ostensibly designed as a vacation spot for the wealthy, golf courses and carts are plentiful. However, you can only carry three batteries at most, so even after finding them, you have to make two trips to transport them all. After finally gathering everything and placing the golden armor in position, thunder and lightning struck, attracting a swarm of monsters to this strange spectacle. I've got a whole arsenal of firearms and melee weapons on me now, so why should I be afraid of you? Bring them on, I'll. take them all down. I ran back to the golden armor to take a look—oh, it's steaming hot, looks like it's cooked and ready to go. Kelvin ran over to join in too; can you read the word "scram"? Donning the freshly forged enchanted golden armor, I returned to the metal door, and this time, it opened successfully. The scene behind the door was like a living hell, with a group of female demons crawling out from the lava . I picked up some small crosses along the way, and to my surprise, holding them actually injures the ghosts. I suspect these crosses are made of Solafite ore, and the radiation they emit can directly harm mutants. Passing.

through the rift, the golden cube is finally right before our eyes. The notebook in my hand is counting down; it’s the activation time for the cube, and there are only a few dozen seconds left. The gate behind us suddenly slammed down. Kevin’s mind stayed sharp at the critical moment, and he darted inside, but Zhang Jianyu, following closely behind, wasn't as lucky and was locked out. As the timer hit zero, the cube was officially activated. Many phantoms appeared around Chimi’s body; these are the versions of Chimi. from parallel universes who were converged into him through a resurrection ritual when he was a child . At this moment, One side of the cube turned into a window, revealing a high-civilization city that doesn't belong to this time and space—it's the same city that often appears in Pav Chimi’s dreams. You can see many souls of the cultists here; it seems they really reached their desired destination, but now they are just drifting spirits—who knows if they are. satisfied with their current state. The cube was only active for a short time before the wall returned to its original state. Chimi’s body wasn't restored by the cube's operation; on the contrary, his mutation became even more severe. As for the guy on the left, that’s Zhang Jianyu. Because he failed to enter the cube in time, his body weight surged, which aligns with the murals we saw earlier: when the cube is running, only those inside are safe. Everyone quickly left the cave and reached the coast, where the protagonist of the first generation, also Chimi’s dad, had already arrived with a helicopter squadron to pick us up. But just at that moment, a massive monster crawled out. from underground. Zhang Jianyu, it’s you again! Having turned into a monster, Zhang Jianyu charged over to ask what we had seen inside the cube. "Hmph, you don't need to worry about that. Buddy, you should focus on yourself first." Min was slapped down by Zhang Jianyu, and in the end, we had to rely on the protagonist’s invincible combat skills, using a pistol , a shotgun, and a bow and arrow in turns to finally take him down. As everyone prepared to board the helicopter to evacuate, the artifact. fragment in the protagonist's backpack was affected by something and suddenly flew out into the air. We also face a choice: if we don't board the helicopter , it means the protagonist remains on the island to study the secrets of the artifacts and cubes. It essentially turns into a survival mode like the first game, allowing us to keep playing . If we evacuate, everyone boards the helicopter and makes a thrilling final escape from this terrifying island. Timmy's mutation is becoming increasingly severe, and his arm has completely taken on a monstrous form, but the Solafite ore found on the island has miraculous healing properties. After relentless efforts, he truly succeeds in.

being cured by the stone. However, this ore isn't a cure-all; for instance, it cannot repair brain damage, such as Kevin's. Through this life-and-death adventure, the protagonist has come to view Kevin as family and decides to look after him for the rest of his life. There are many Easter eggs hidden during the end credits. After being cured, Timmy founded a company to research the medical applications of Solafite, becoming a leader in the pharmaceutical industry, while the protagonist, Jack, wrote a bestselling novel about this experience titled "My Story." Soon, another new island was discovered, which also contained vast amounts of Solafite. ore. Timmy's company won the rights to the island through a bid to begin extraction , but he went missing after the successful bid; no one knows where he went or what happened to him. These are all hints the developers have laid for*Sons of the Forest 3*. From the trailer, we can see the location is no longer on Earth. As for whether it’s a planet with an advanced civilization in a parallel universe, or if Timmy is there, we can only guess until the game releases. There is also a more perfect ending in the game—or at least, more perfect in my opinion. To achieve this ending, you must first find Puffton's. daughter, Virginia. You could initially see Virginia's name tag in the cafeteria , but she wasn't there in person. In fact, while exploring the island, we often see a mildly mutated woman with three legs and three arms; if you compare her to the photo, you'll know she is Virginia. At first, she only dares to watch us from afar. You must stay calm and not harm her; soon, Virginia will gradually approach, occasionally bringing us gifts or coming over to steal our dried meat. Once you become more familiar, you can not only change her clothes but also equip her with weapons to help fight together. At this point, the "missus" has officially. joined the team. Everyone enters the cube together and evacuates together, with Virginia and Timmy both using the Solafite ore for their respective treatments. Five months later, when Virginia appeared on camera again, not only was her condition completely cured , but her belly was showing—she was pregnant! This follows the will Pav had left on the island earlier, in which he bequeathed his entire 8-billion fortune to Virginia. With such a beautiful and talented wife by his side, it looks like the protagonist is set for life.

monster looks like a spider at first, but if you look closer, it’s more like two people fused together, crawling on their hands. "Room Cup" on the island. Sahara had researched this cup and reached a shocking conclusion: it can connect our current spacetime to other parallel universes. human form with a lower degree of mutation. After growing up, Timmy wrote a book, combining his experiences and strange dreams to discuss his theories on parallel universes. This is Pav's official narrative to the public, meant to secure high-level funding while covering up the truth: the. Golden Cube they discovered deep underground. The Pav Group’s research on the Cube has not been smooth sailing; they have a powerful rival, the pharmaceutical company "Sahara" from the previous game . They planted an undercover agent within the Pav Group, the game's most important villain, "Zhang Jianyu," who was the one.

who knocked the protagonist out with a pistol whip at the beginning. This person holds the position of legal counsel for the Pav Group, giving him access to top-secret information, but the group soon realized how dangerous he was. From secret emails, it’s clear that Pav has assigned his trusted subordinates to keep a close watch on Zhang Jianyu’s every move while continuing research on the Cube. They have found a way to soft-boot the Cube, and after a period of time, it will be activated, though what will happen after that is impossible to predict. Some of those in the know are deeply worried, feeling that the risks are too high and the Cube should not be activated lightly. . But Puff insisted on launching the activation project, while simultaneously sensing Zhang Jianyu's ambition and the closing net of the Sahara Company. Knowing he was in danger, Puff made arrangements that if anything happened to him, they should immediately contact the protagonist, Jack, to bring help to the island. In fact, Jack is not a private investigator or a special forces operative; he is a media professional, and you can find a biography he wrote about Puff on the island. Puff deeply trusted this media professional he had frequent contact with, believing that even in the worst-case scenario, Jack's arrival would at least protect his. daughter, Virginia. Puff is worthy of being the founder of a major conglomerate; overall, he has a clear head and foresight, having indeed anticipated many things. Combined with the underground bunker discovered during the investigation, 31 weeks ago, the Puff Group invited celebrities from all walks of life to dine there and announce some of their research findings. However , through the surveillance room footage , one could see these celebrities, including Puff and his wife, all mutating into twisted monsters in almost an instant. The protagonist, bold and daring, used a VIP keycard to open the dining hall door , and the scene he witnessed was exactly as seen on the monitors, though there was another group there besides him. Zhang Jianyu had also arrived here with his men. After confirming that the Puff couple had mutated into monsters and seeing the protagonist arrive, Zhang Jianyu didn't waste any words, jumping out of a window and escaping quickly via an underground river, leaving the protagonist to deal with the couple. alone. I must say, these two don't look very agile, but they are quite difficult to handle; being hit by their heavy punches will knock you straight to the ground. The good news is that the Puff couple now recognizes no one, attacking the other monsters in the room with heavy blows indiscriminately. It took quite a lot of effort to eliminate all the monsters, including the couple themselves. After investigating the table, I found the name tag of Puff's daughter, Virginia, confirming that she must have been here at the time, though she is nowhere to be found now. Continuing the exploration, I found a cave on the other side of the island; it was initially just a narrow crevice, but inside it opened up into a whole new.

world. While fighting monsters and fumbling forward, I surprisingly discovered an ancient ruin, with walls and passages made of a special metal. Here, one can find another mural depicting the golden cube, once again hinting that as long as a person is inside the cube, they are safe. But this cave is far from safe, filled with mutated monsters everywhere, especially the flesh-mountain mutants which are tough to kill. Surprisingly, I encountered three of them in a row that got glitched; I was really lucky. Don't forget to triple-tap that like button! Deep in the cave, I found many corpses, and the clothes they were wearing looked just like spacesuits. Walking a bit further, I looked up to see an even more. shocking sight: before me was a spacecraft that didn't belong to this era, or perhaps, didn't belong to this dimension at all. Lightning kept striking the ship's hull from above. Inside the ship, there were many wooden crosses, and a corpse at the very front —likely the pilot. The small orb in his hand is one of the artifact fragments; several others can be found elsewhere on the island. The golden armor he's wearing is a vital item—I’m definitely taking it. As for where the ship and the astronauts actually came from, the game doesn't explicitly state it, so I can only guess. They likely traveled here from another dimension. The Puffton. Corporation also discovered these astronauts, which further convinced them that the cube could facilitate travel between parallel universes. The environment on the island is becoming increasingly perilous, but Jack has finally located the golden cube. The Puffton Corporation built an underground facility, with the couple's living quarters at the deepest level. The wall behind their bathroom has been blown open by the cultists, revealing a passage that leads to a sealed metal door. Jie had already arrived here, but no matter how hard we both tried, we couldn't open the door. After searching around, I found a note on a nearby corpse; the drawings on it were the key. clue to opening the door. I have to say , this part is really tedious; we have to find four golf cart batteries. Golf carts are a new vehicle in this installment. Since the island was ostensibly designed as a vacation spot for the wealthy, golf courses and carts are plentiful. However, you can only carry three batteries at most, so even after finding them, you have to make two trips to transport them all. After finally gathering everything and placing the golden armor in position, thunder and lightning struck, attracting a swarm of monsters to this strange spectacle. I've got a whole arsenal of firearms and melee weapons on me now, so why should I be afraid of you? Bring them on, I'll. take them all down. I ran back to the golden armor to take a look—oh, it's steaming hot, looks like it's cooked and ready to go. Kelvin ran over to join in too; can you read the word "scram"? Donning the freshly forged enchanted golden armor, I returned to the metal door, and this time, it opened successfully. The scene behind the door was like a living hell, with a group of female demons crawling out from the lava . I picked up some small crosses along the way, and to my surprise, holding them actually injures the ghosts. through the rift, the golden cube is finally right before our eyes. The notebook in my hand is counting down; it’s the activation time for the cube, and there are only a few dozen seconds left. As the timer hit zero, the cube was officially activated. Many phantoms appeared around Chimi’s body; these are the versions of Chimi. from parallel universes who were converged into him through a resurrection ritual when he was a child . At this moment, One side of the cube turned into a window, revealing a high-civilization city that doesn't belong to this time and space—it's the same city that often appears in Pav Chimi’s dreams. You can see many souls of the cultists here; it seems they really reached their desired destination, but now they are just drifting spirits—who knows if they are. satisfied with their current state. The cube was only active for a short time before the wall returned to its original state. Chimi’s body wasn't restored by the cube's operation; on the contrary, his mutation became even more severe. As for the guy on the left, that’s Zhang Jianyu. Because he failed to enter the cube in time, his body weight surged, which aligns with the murals we saw earlier: when the cube is running, only those inside are safe. Everyone quickly left the cave and reached the coast, where the protagonist of the first generation, also Chimi’s dad, had already arrived with a helicopter squadron to pick us up. But just at that moment, a massive monster crawled out. from underground. Zhang Jianyu, it’s you again! Having turned into a monster, Zhang Jianyu charged over to ask what we had seen inside the cube. "Hmph, you don't need to worry about that. Buddy, you should focus on yourself first." Min was slapped down by Zhang Jianyu, and in the end, we had to rely on the protagonist’s invincible combat skills, using a pistol , a shotgun, and a bow and arrow in turns to finally take him down. As everyone prepared to board the helicopter to evacuate, the artifact. fragment in the protagonist's backpack was affected by something and suddenly flew out into the air. We also face a choice: if we don't board the helicopter , it means the protagonist remains on the island to study the secrets of the artifacts and cubes. It essentially turns into a survival mode like the first game, allowing us to keep playing . If we evacuate, everyone boards the helicopter and makes a thrilling final escape from this terrifying island. Timmy's mutation is becoming increasingly severe, and his arm has completely taken on a monstrous form, but the Solafite ore found on the island has miraculous healing properties. After relentless efforts, he truly succeeds in.

being cured by the stone. However, this ore isn't a cure-all; for instance, it cannot repair brain damage, such as Kevin's. Through this life-and-death adventure, the protagonist has come to view Kevin as family and decides to look after him for the rest of his life. There are many Easter eggs hidden during the end credits. After being cured, Timmy founded a company to research the medical applications of Solafite, becoming a leader in the pharmaceutical industry, while the protagonist, Jack, wrote a bestselling novel about this experience titled "My Story." Soon, another new island was discovered, which also contained vast amounts of Solafite. ore. Timmy's company won the rights to the island through a bid to begin extraction , but he went missing after the successful bid; no one knows where he went or what happened to him. These are all hints the developers have laid for*Sons of the Forest 3*. From the trailer, we can see the location is no longer on Earth. As for whether it’s a planet with an advanced civilization in a parallel universe, or if Timmy is there, we can only guess until the game releases. There is also a more perfect ending in the game—or at least, more perfect in my opinion. To achieve this ending, you must first find Puffton's. daughter, Virginia. You could initially see Virginia's name tag in the cafeteria , but she wasn't there in person. In fact, while exploring the island, we often see a mildly mutated woman with three legs and three arms; if you compare her to the photo, you'll know she is Virginia. At first, she only dares to watch us from afar. You must stay calm and not harm her; soon, Virginia will gradually approach, occasionally bringing us gifts or coming over to steal our dried meat. Once you become more familiar, you can not only change her clothes but also equip her with weapons to help fight together. At this point, the "missus" has officially. joined the team. Everyone enters the cube together and evacuates together, with Virginia and Timmy both using the Solafite ore for their respective treatments. Five months later, when Virginia appeared on camera again, not only was her condition completely cured , but her belly was showing—she was pregnant! This follows the will Pav had left on the island earlier, in which he bequeathed his entire 8-billion fortune to Virginia. With such a beautiful and talented wife by his side, it looks like the protagonist is set for life.

Thinking they had arrived at a sunny paradise, they actually stepped into a purgatory. But the rich aren't stupid; they should have at least conducted thorough surveys of the island . How could they choose to build a resort in such a place? Or perhaps, did these monsters only appear after they arrived? Until the protagonist also landed on this island. The truth of. everything was gradually revealed with the 2023 release of the sequel to*The Forest*, *Sons of the Forest*. The hallmark of this series is that it doesn't spell out the story; all clues must be pieced together like unraveling a mystery from what we see and read. It also touches on content from the first game, so if you haven't played the prequel, you'll be left in the dark. The game has undergone several major updates , so the content and ending we see now are completely different from the initial stages. If you've watched early videos or played the game a long time ago, it's worth watching along. *The Forest*is too chaotic and visually overwhelming in multiplayer, so when covering the main storyline, I'll be playing solo and embarking on this adventure on this picturesque island with all of you. Protagonist. Protagonist Jack and a team of mercenaries arrive by helicopter over a small island. This island was previously bought by PuffCorp to be turned into a luxury vacation resort for the wealthy, but 31 weeks ago, everyone on the island went missing, including PuffCorp chairman Edward Puff, his wife , and their daughter Virginia. Jack and his team came to the island to find the whereabouts of the chairman's family, but as soon as they arrived over the island, they were attacked by unknown armed forces. The helicopter plummeted under heavy fire, and Jack was thrown from the craft ; before he could react, the chopper crashed into him, which hurt a bit. Waking up, a stranger stood before him, originally intending to. Finish Jack off , but for some unknown reason, after a brief hesitation, he just knocked him unconscious. Waking up again, he found himself unharmed, and his emergency. supplies had also fallen beside him. Don't let the small size of this folded backpack fool you; it can actually hold a massive amount of gear. The bag currently contains an axe, a GPS, a crafting guidebook, and the standard nuclear lighter. However, this one is now windproof, so its lighting effect inside the caves isn't quite as good. After looking around, I found another survivor named Kelvin. He was part of the armed team, but he likely hit his head, causing damage to his intelligence and hearing. He can't communicate verbally, so I have to give him orders using written notes. From then on, Kelvin stayed by my side as a helpful assistant. However, he won't enter caves.

or underground areas; he only helps out when we're operating in the wild. The mountain is covered in snow, but after heading down for a while, the scenery gradually turns green. The weather is nice and sunny today, but the protagonist is in no mood to enjoy the scenery; the top priority is finding the other companions from the plane. Using the GPS to track their locations, the first teammate was found hanging from a cliff by a rope—no one knows by whom. Cutting the rope allows you to head down and loot his gear. Another teammate's signal was in the ocean. I ran over and found him shot dead on a life raft, clearly killed while trying to escape the island. The good news is that I found a pistol next to him. The bad news. is that there's a shark nearby, and swimming back blindly would surely... result in getting bitten. There's no other way; I have no choice but to start a fight. Sigh, what a waste of a precious bullet. You can also find the corpses of other armed personnel on the island. They wear the same uniforms as the helicopter crew, but they weren't part of our group. They must have come to the island for search and rescue earlier, but were attacked and killed. In many places, you can also find dead miners; it seems this armed group didn't even spare the workers. Jack’s heart sank, and he could only take the silent Kelvin with him to start uncovering the secrets of the island. The map in the. second game is several times larger than the first. The seasons are distinct, and if you live on the island long enough, you can see the scenery change across spring, summer, autumn, and winter. The protagonist of the previous game was a survival expert who could craft complex items. This entry has significantly simplified crafting requirements; for example, you only need two sticks to build a campfire. Saving is also very convenient. You just need to place a tarp on the ground and prop it up with a stick to create a simple shelter for sleeping and saving. Although the energy recovered is minimal, we can also restore it by drinking beverages or eating food; there are many ways. There are many cannibal camps on the island. Regardless of their size or type, these cannibals attack on sight. Ordinary cannibals can be taken down with a single headshot from a bow, but these strong cannibals wearing golden masks take two or three shots to kill, which is quite troublesome. Burning the cannibals 'bodies and crafting some bone armor can provide effective protection for your body. Defense—besides the cannibals, there are even more terrifying monsters on the island. Sometimes, the cannibals even kidnap monsters and bring them back, perhaps as a reserve food supply? The cannibals in this village captured a monster we used to call the "Finger Monster." Just look at how many arrows I shot to know how hard this thing is to fight if it’s not. tied up. Encounter. Dealing with cannibals is one thing, but the island’s caves are the truly terrifying part. You need nerves of steel to explore them alone. The light is dim, filled with all sorts of shrieks; you might get a "surprise" at any moment. A flare to the face reveals a Finger Monster. Their attack power is insane—they shattered my bones in just two or three hits. There’s also what we call the basic mob, the most common enemy in the caves. They usually appear in groups of three or four. They have no eyes and rely on sound to navigate, so you can just sneak around them. This.

monster looks like a spider at first, but if you look closer, it’s more like two people fused together, crawling on their hands. The best strategy is to target their limbs first to stun them, then it’s easier to focus your fire. This mountain of flesh has massive HP, wasting tons of ammo to kill. But because they are so bulky, they often glitch out—like this one, which is now just a target dummy. There are many other monsters, too. Every so often, you see bizarre-looking creatures. The whole island underground is a chaotic, bustling nest of demons. Beyond the monsters, the caves also show traces of human activity. Here’s an ancient mural painted in gold, depicting a cube. People around it are either lying on the ground or in strange poses, while those inside the cube seem perfectly fine. Deep inside a cave, I found traces of man-made structures. Yes, this isn't a deserted island. After PuffCorp bought it, they hired tons of workers to build underground facilities, planning to turn it into a paradise resort. This bunker is fully equipped now. The 3D printer nearby can print all sorts of things,. including arrows and water flasks. You can even print a mask to wear, which is great for scaring off regular cannibals . Inside the bunker, there's also a book about parallel universes, written by Timmy, the son of the first game's protagonist. From this moment on, the island's secrets slowly began to unravel . One. The protagonist's plane crashes on a small island, and his son, Timmy, is kidnapped. The kidnapper was a researcher for the giant pharmaceutical company, Sahara, and took Timmy to use as a sacrifice to resurrect his own daughter, because there is a mysterious. "Room Cup" on the island. Sahara had researched this cup and reached a shocking conclusion: it can connect our current spacetime to other parallel universes. By linking these spaces, it can pull a version of one's life from a parallel universe into a current body, thereby allowing the dead to be resurrected. However, it first requires a life to be sacrificed. By the time the protagonist found his son Timmy, he had already been sacrificed. The protagonist was naturally devastated, and he then did something unthinkable: he used the artifact to bring down another plane flying over the island, sacrificing an innocent person to trade for his son. Timmy's life. In fact, all previous resurrection experiments with the Room Cup had failed, resulting in bodies turning into indescribable monsters; even that researcher couldn't succeed. But Timmy's resurrection actually worked , though his body didn't return to its exact original state; his arms would swell and mutate, which he had to struggle to suppress each time. Regarding why Timmy's resurrection was successful, one theory is that because Timmy had already been sacrificed once, there was a "true self" of his in a parallel universe. This was equivalent to pulling his original self back, which is why he was able to barely maintain a.

human form with a lower degree of mutation. After growing up, Timmy wrote a book, combining his experiences and strange dreams to discuss his theories on parallel universes. His book caught the attention of the Pav Group, as Pav himself was very interested in things like parallel spacetime. Through investigation, they discovered that there is a type of "Solafite" ore on this island—a special metal that possesses magical powers. At the same time, there is an even stranger golden cube on the island, which looks as if it were crafted from Solafite ore. This cube might be like the Room Cup, possessing the ability to shift. dimensions and thereby connect to another spacetime. The Pav Group won the competition against Sahara, gaining the rights to develop the island. Initially , they publicly claimed they would turn the island into a vacation paradise for the wealthy, then later made a high-profile announcement that they had discovered Solafite ore on the island. They claimed the ore has magical properties, and if its mysteries can be unlocked, it might eventually lead to the development of technology to delay aging or even achieve human immortality . This is Pav's official narrative to the public, meant to secure high-level funding while covering up the truth: the. Golden Cube they discovered deep underground. In reality, Kimi had already landed on the island by this time. You encounter him while exploring underground, where you can see his hand mutation has become increasingly severe . Kimi and the protagonist clearly knew each other before, as he warns that this place is extremely unsafe and tells him to leave, before heading off himself. Kimi’s goal for this trip is to use the Cube to find a way to fix his body. After discovering the Cube, Pav, the boss of the Pav Group, moved onto the island to live, and he often has dreams about parallel universes, even dreaming of being in a city that is clearly not. of human civilization. Because he keeps having the same dream, Pav sketched out the scenes from them, and later, it becomes clear that his dreams were quite accurate. This happens because the area where Pav lives is very close to the Golden Cube, and since he is a sensitive individual, he is highly reactive to the radiation emitted by the Cube, allowing him to see these strange visions. But the Golden Cube didn’t just attract the Pav Group; there are also many robed corpses on the island who could perceive the Cube's radiation, and they formed a cult called "Neo-Knowledge," fanatically worshipping the Cube and the mysterious. city from their dreams. They believe that by discarding their physical bodies on this island, they can reach that mysterious city, so crowds have come to the island to end their lives, and you can see how insane they are from the blurry footage on the security tapes. The Pav Group’s research on the Cube has not been smooth sailing; they have a powerful rival, the pharmaceutical company "Sahara" from the previous game . Sahara lost the competition for the island but never gave up their obsession with the mysterious object found there. They planted an undercover agent within the Pav Group, the game's most important villain, "Zhang Jianyu," who was the one.

who knocked the protagonist out with a pistol whip at the beginning. This person holds the position of legal counsel for the Pav Group, giving him access to top-secret information, but the group soon realized how dangerous he was. From secret emails, it’s clear that Pav has assigned his trusted subordinates to keep a close watch on Zhang Jianyu’s every move while continuing research on the Cube. They have found a way to soft-boot the Cube, and after a period of time, it will be activated, though what will happen after that is impossible to predict. Some of those in the know are deeply worried, feeling that the risks are too high and the Cube should not be activated lightly. . But Puff insisted on launching the activation project, while simultaneously sensing Zhang Jianyu's ambition and the closing net of the Sahara Company. Knowing he was in danger, Puff made arrangements that if anything happened to him, they should immediately contact the protagonist, Jack, to bring help to the island. In fact, Jack is not a private investigator or a special forces operative; he is a media professional, and you can find a biography he wrote about Puff on the island. Puff deeply trusted this media professional he had frequent contact with, believing that even in the worst-case scenario, Jack's arrival would at least protect his. daughter, Virginia. Puff is worthy of being the founder of a major conglomerate; overall, he has a clear head and foresight, having indeed anticipated many things. Combined with the underground bunker discovered during the investigation, 31 weeks ago, the Puff Group invited celebrities from all walks of life to dine there and announce some of their research findings. However , through the surveillance room footage , one could see these celebrities, including Puff and his wife, all mutating into twisted monsters in almost an instant. The protagonist, bold and daring, used a VIP keycard to open the dining hall door , and the scene he witnessed was exactly as seen on the monitors, though there was another group there besides him. Zhang Jianyu had also arrived here with his men. After confirming that the Puff couple had mutated into monsters and seeing the protagonist arrive, Zhang Jianyu didn't waste any words, jumping out of a window and escaping quickly via an underground river, leaving the protagonist to deal with the couple. alone. I must say, these two don't look very agile, but they are quite difficult to handle; being hit by their heavy punches will knock you straight to the ground. The good news is that the Puff couple now recognizes no one, attacking the other monsters in the room with heavy blows indiscriminately. It took quite a lot of effort to eliminate all the monsters, including the couple themselves. After investigating the table, I found the name tag of Puff's daughter, Virginia, confirming that she must have been here at the time, though she is nowhere to be found now. Continuing the exploration, I found a cave on the other side of the island; it was initially just a narrow crevice, but inside it opened up into a whole new.

world. While fighting monsters and fumbling forward, I surprisingly discovered an ancient ruin, with walls and passages made of a special metal. Here, one can find another mural depicting the golden cube, once again hinting that as long as a person is inside the cube, they are safe. But this cave is far from safe, filled with mutated monsters everywhere, especially the flesh-mountain mutants which are tough to kill. Surprisingly, I encountered three of them in a row that got glitched; I was really lucky. Don't forget to triple-tap that like button! Deep in the cave, I found many corpses, and the clothes they were wearing looked just like spacesuits. Walking a bit further, I looked up to see an even more. shocking sight: before me was a spacecraft that didn't belong to this era, or perhaps, didn't belong to this dimension at all. Lightning kept striking the ship's hull from above. Inside the ship, there were many wooden crosses, and a corpse at the very front —likely the pilot. The small orb in his hand is one of the artifact fragments; several others can be found elsewhere on the island. The golden armor he's wearing is a vital item—I’m definitely taking it. As for where the ship and the astronauts actually came from, the game doesn't explicitly state it, so I can only guess. They likely traveled here from another dimension. The Puffton. Corporation also discovered these astronauts, which further convinced them that the cube could facilitate travel between parallel universes. The environment on the island is becoming increasingly perilous, but Jack has finally located the golden cube. The Puffton Corporation built an underground facility, with the couple's living quarters at the deepest level. The wall behind their bathroom has been blown open by the cultists, revealing a passage that leads to a sealed metal door. Jie had already arrived here, but no matter how hard we both tried, we couldn't open the door. After searching around, I found a note on a nearby corpse; the drawings on it were the key. clue to opening the door. I have to say , this part is really tedious; we have to find four golf cart batteries. Golf carts are a new vehicle in this installment. Since the island was ostensibly designed as a vacation spot for the wealthy, golf courses and carts are plentiful. However, you can only carry three batteries at most, so even after finding them, you have to make two trips to transport them all. After finally gathering everything and placing the golden armor in position, thunder and lightning struck, attracting a swarm of monsters to this strange spectacle. I've got a whole arsenal of firearms and melee weapons on me now, so why should I be afraid of you? Bring them on, I'll. take them all down. I ran back to the golden armor to take a look—oh, it's steaming hot, looks like it's cooked and ready to go. Kelvin ran over to join in too; can you read the word "scram"? Donning the freshly forged enchanted golden armor, I returned to the metal door, and this time, it opened successfully. The scene behind the door was like a living hell, with a group of female demons crawling out from the lava . I picked up some small crosses along the way, and to my surprise, holding them actually injures the ghosts. I suspect these crosses are made of Solafite ore, and the radiation they emit can directly harm mutants. Passing.

through the rift, the golden cube is finally right before our eyes. The notebook in my hand is counting down; it’s the activation time for the cube, and there are only a few dozen seconds left. The gate behind us suddenly slammed down. Kevin’s mind stayed sharp at the critical moment, and he darted inside, but Zhang Jianyu, following closely behind, wasn't as lucky and was locked out. As the timer hit zero, the cube was officially activated. Many phantoms appeared around Chimi’s body; these are the versions of Chimi. from parallel universes who were converged into him through a resurrection ritual when he was a child . At this moment, One side of the cube turned into a window, revealing a high-civilization city that doesn't belong to this time and space—it's the same city that often appears in Pav Chimi’s dreams. You can see many souls of the cultists here; it seems they really reached their desired destination, but now they are just drifting spirits—who knows if they are. satisfied with their current state. The cube was only active for a short time before the wall returned to its original state. Chimi’s body wasn't restored by the cube's operation; on the contrary, his mutation became even more severe. As for the guy on the left, that’s Zhang Jianyu. Because he failed to enter the cube in time, his body weight surged, which aligns with the murals we saw earlier: when the cube is running, only those inside are safe. Everyone quickly left the cave and reached the coast, where the protagonist of the first generation, also Chimi’s dad, had already arrived with a helicopter squadron to pick us up. But just at that moment, a massive monster crawled out. from underground. Zhang Jianyu, it’s you again! Having turned into a monster, Zhang Jianyu charged over to ask what we had seen inside the cube. "Hmph, you don't need to worry about that. Buddy, you should focus on yourself first." Min was slapped down by Zhang Jianyu, and in the end, we had to rely on the protagonist’s invincible combat skills, using a pistol , a shotgun, and a bow and arrow in turns to finally take him down. As everyone prepared to board the helicopter to evacuate, the artifact. fragment in the protagonist's backpack was affected by something and suddenly flew out into the air. We also face a choice: if we don't board the helicopter , it means the protagonist remains on the island to study the secrets of the artifacts and cubes. It essentially turns into a survival mode like the first game, allowing us to keep playing . If we evacuate, everyone boards the helicopter and makes a thrilling final escape from this terrifying island. Timmy's mutation is becoming increasingly severe, and his arm has completely taken on a monstrous form, but the Solafite ore found on the island has miraculous healing properties. After relentless efforts, he truly succeeds in.

being cured by the stone. However, this ore isn't a cure-all; for instance, it cannot repair brain damage, such as Kevin's. Through this life-and-death adventure, the protagonist has come to view Kevin as family and decides to look after him for the rest of his life. There are many Easter eggs hidden during the end credits. After being cured, Timmy founded a company to research the medical applications of Solafite, becoming a leader in the pharmaceutical industry, while the protagonist, Jack, wrote a bestselling novel about this experience titled "My Story." Soon, another new island was discovered, which also contained vast amounts of Solafite. ore. Timmy's company won the rights to the island through a bid to begin extraction , but he went missing after the successful bid; no one knows where he went or what happened to him. These are all hints the developers have laid for*Sons of the Forest 3*. From the trailer, we can see the location is no longer on Earth. As for whether it’s a planet with an advanced civilization in a parallel universe, or if Timmy is there, we can only guess until the game releases. There is also a more perfect ending in the game—or at least, more perfect in my opinion. To achieve this ending, you must first find Puffton's. daughter, Virginia. You could initially see Virginia's name tag in the cafeteria , but she wasn't there in person. In fact, while exploring the island, we often see a mildly mutated woman with three legs and three arms; if you compare her to the photo, you'll know she is Virginia. At first, she only dares to watch us from afar. You must stay calm and not harm her; soon, Virginia will gradually approach, occasionally bringing us gifts or coming over to steal our dried meat. Once you become more familiar, you can not only change her clothes but also equip her with weapons to help fight together. At this point, the "missus" has officially. joined the team. Everyone enters the cube together and evacuates together, with Virginia and Timmy both using the Solafite ore for their respective treatments. Five months later, when Virginia appeared on camera again, not only was her condition completely cured , but her belly was showing—she was pregnant! This follows the will Pav had left on the island earlier, in which he bequeathed his entire 8-billion fortune to Virginia. With such a beautiful and talented wife by his side, it looks like the protagonist is set for life.

值得閱讀的理由

  • 回顧《拳皇》從 1994 年推出到成為街機經典的歷程，重溫系列玩法與人氣高峰。
  • 梳理大蛇篇的重要角色與劇情，從八神庵登場到大蛇再度被封印，了解經典篇章的來龍去脈。
  • 呈現《拳皇》如何延續至今，並介紹手機遊戲《拳皇全明星》中熟悉角色與全新養成玩法。

摘要

《拳皇》開創三人組隊對戰

作者回憶，1994 年推出的《拳皇》（KOF）以三人一隊的對戰方式，為習慣一對一格鬥的玩家帶來新鮮感。初代角色相當脆弱，必殺技往往能迅速削去大量體力，勝負常在短時間內分曉；儘管仍有不少小缺點，《拳皇 ’94》依然大獲成功，系列也曾長年維持一年推出一作的節奏。

街機熱潮與大蛇篇

《拳皇 ’95》的隱藏選角指令，曾讓玩家有機會使用草薙京、盧卡爾等頭目角色，成為孩子們津津樂道的秘密；但頭目實在太強，之後便無法再透過同樣方式選用。隨著連段、角色與系統逐步豐富，系列在《拳皇 ’97》迎來人氣高峰，甚至有店家把街機全數換成這一代。對許多九〇年代泡在遊樂場的玩家來說，串聯 ’95、’96 與 ’97 的大蛇篇尤其令人難忘。

八神庵與大蛇的宿命

八神庵於《拳皇 ’95》登場，外型參考日本搖滾樂團 Boøwy 的主唱；在設定中，他不只是格鬥家，也是音樂愛好者，還會在自己的虛構樂團中演奏貝斯。八神家與草薙家世代為敵，八神參賽的目的，是在賽事中殺死草薙京；他的登場也正式揭開大蛇篇序幕。

到了《拳皇 ’96》，身兼大會主辦者的神樂千鶴，希望草薙京與八神庵聯手，迎戰即將復活的大蛇。大蛇是象徵地球意志的神祇，因人類破壞地球而決意消滅人類，並企圖藉由尋找八名特殊女子獻祭，恢復力量並取得肉身。約一千八百年前，草薙、八尺瓊與八咫三族合力將其封印；如今封印逐漸鬆動，大蛇再度面臨復活。

《拳皇 ’97》的決戰

《拳皇 ’96》中，眾人必須對抗大蛇的部下高尼茨。雖然他未必是系列最強頭目，仍讓玩家費盡心力才能擊敗；臨死前，他引發八神庵體內的血之暴走，促成了《拳皇 ’97》中廣為人知的「暴走八神」登場。

在《拳皇 ’97》的大會中，大蛇終於復活。暴走的八神抓住大蛇，草薙京則使出最終奧義「無式」，能量爆發席捲整座會場，最後再次將大蛇封印。許多玩家因此視 ’97 為系列巔峰：劇情高潮鮮明，草薙京在爆炸中消失留下的懸念，也替續作鋪陳了期待。

新主角接棒，系列持續發光

《拳皇 ’99》揭曉草薙京回歸，還出現了不只一個與他相似的身影；更受矚目的變化，則是新主角K’華麗登場，接替草薙京與八神庵成為故事核心。作者認為，SNK 更換主角的策略讓故事得以拓展，也為後續作品留下發展空間。即使 SNK 在九〇年代末經歷破產與重整，《拳皇》系列仍未中斷，草薙京、八神庵、大蛇、不知火舞、麻宮雅典娜與 K’ 等角色至今仍廣受喜愛，相關賽事也持續舉辦。

在《拳皇全明星》中再度集結

接著，作者介紹手機遊戲《拳皇全明星》。遊戲中，熟悉的 KOF 角色會陸續登場，但玩家扮演的是自己創建的經理人角色，而非系列格鬥家。與九〇年代格鬥遊戲講究複雜連段不同，這款作品著重角色培養與隊伍成長。遊戲一開始便能招募草薙京、二階堂紅丸與大門五郎，之後不知火舞、克拉克、八神庵、羅伯特等人氣角色也會加入；每日登入則有機會收集更多格鬥家。

角色分為三種類型，彼此具有類似剪刀石頭布的相剋關係；隨著冒險推進，也會開放不同模式。街頭訓練可放置取得素材與獎勵，遊樂園則有機會透過轉盤獲得大蛇。作者表示自己很快便抽到大蛇，也取得了強力角色「大蛇八神」，也就是傳說中的暴走八神；過去街機店甚至會張貼禁止選用暴走八神的告示。作者將他與大蛇及大蛇克里斯編入同一隊，藉此重現昔日壓制對手的想像。

作者最後推薦《拳皇全明星》，邀請玩家一邊體驗經理人養成，一邊看著熟悉的格鬥家逐漸變強。影片並以遊戲宣傳作結，提到下載可獲得一千次免費抽卡與一名傳說角色，下載連結則放在影片說明欄。

In 1994, the groundbreaking fighting game "The King of Fighters," or KOF for short, was released. In Chinese, it's known as "Quan Huang,""Ge Dou Qian Wang ," or "Ge Dou Zhi Wang." Every battle in the game features three fighters against another three. This mode was a breath of fresh air for those of us used to one-on-one matches! Wow, you can play like this? Doesn't that mean I have three lives? If I lose one, I still have two more—what a bargain! Actually, the characters in '94 were quite fragile. A single special move could instantly wipe out half a health bar, and a match could end in seconds. It really was about. winning or losing quickly. But despite many minor issues, KOF '94 was a huge success, and the series subsequently became an annual release. For many years , a new KOF title would appear every year. I remember KOF '95 had a secret boss select code. By holding Start at the character select screen and inputting Up, Down, Forward, Back, A, D , bosses like Kyo and Rugal became playable. characters. KOF '97 reached its peak, instantly sweeping through every arcade , big or small. Some owners even replaced all their cabinets with KOF '97 ; it was truly outrageous. In the lore, besides being a fighter, Iori is also a music enthusiast and even plays bass in his own virtual band. The Yagami and Kusanagi families are sworn enemies. His purpose for joining the tournament was clear: to kill Kyo Kusanagi during the competition. His debut also marked the official beginning of the Orochi Saga. In KOF '96, the boss Chizuru Kagura, who was also the tournament organizer, aimed to bring Kyo and Iori together to confront the soon-to-be-resurrected Orochi.
